Domestic supply therefore remains unverified — not confirmed and not excluded.
note: Direction of the only available customs dataset is import, not export: the 5 visible rows show foreign manufacturers (Chiali Tubes SPA — Algeria, Metzerplas — Israel, Wade Rain de Mexico — Mexico) shipping drip-irrigation fittings, filters and nozzles (HS 84248200, 84249000) into Tuglakabad ICD, Delhi. That is evidence of purchasing/trading activity, not of the company's own outbound shipments, so it cannot be used to claim export fact. Declared HS codes 820570 (clamps/vices), 842121 (filtering machinery) and 848180 (taps/valves) do not match the observed 8424 lines; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the factual code is 8424 (mechanical appliances for projecting/dispersing/spraying liquids), and the declared set should be corrected to include 8424. No export bill-of-lading number, no export date and no export destination were found, so export_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' — the free view is truncated (5 of 16,058 rows) and the export subset is paywalled, so absence is not established. No traces of outbound supply confirmed on either channel; treat as unverified pending a paid customs pull or GST/GeM check. Revenue and export volume: null (not public on free sources).
